mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% over the next month predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in >70% of CPIAUCSL > 0.3 events, or inflation decelerates within 2 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as firms pass cost increases to consumers via higher equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >50% of PAYEMS > 0.5 events, or labor cost growth reverses within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% for two months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak demand reduces corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such GDPC1 declines, or consumption rebounds within 4 weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in INDPRO manufacturing production index above 2% followed by a 5-day drop in RSAFS retail sales predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as supply chain expansion offsets demand softness.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 2 and RSAFS < -5 in the same month
regime_hint: supply expansion offset by weak retail demand
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >40% of such events, or INDPRO falls below 1.5 within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% creates a persistent discounting effect, producing a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets price in lower future policy rates.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are non-positive in >50% of such periods, or FEDFUNDS rises above 1 within 15 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE drop below 5% signals labor market slack, which precedes a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate weaker wage growth and slower economic expansion.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are non-negative in >70% of UNRATE < 5 events, or UNRATE recovers within 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in HOUST housing starts of at least 4% followed by a 10-day decline in PAYEMS employment forecast imply a positive 20-day S&P 500 return as housing cycle strength offsets labor weakness.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 4 and PAYEMS < -2 in the same month
regime_hint: resilient housing cycle vs labor softness
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >50% of such events, or employment rises above forecast within 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time 2% monthly jump in INDPRO coinciding with a 3% drop in RSAFS retail sales in the same month predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as supply outpaces demand, raising recession risk.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > INDPRO_prev_month*1.02 and RSAFS < RSAFS_prev_month*0.97 in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >40% of such events, or demand recovers faster than supply within 4 months.
